recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中大多是中型原始細胞：圓核、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，胞質為淡灰藍色中等量且無顆粒，背景有碎屑，只剩少數中性球與有核紅血球；符合 ALL，T 細胞系需免疫表型確認。
features: Predominance of medium-sized blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with one or more small nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Occasional small dense cells, erythroid precursors and a segmented neutrophil
Background with granular debris and bare nuclei
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of medium-sized blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate rim of agranular grey-blue cytoplasm. Residual erythroid precursors and a rare segmented neutrophil are present, and the background contains granular debris. No Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; defined by CD19/CD79a/CD22 expression without cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts with moderate cytoplasm can look similar but express MPO, CD13, CD33 or CD117.
MPAL shows a single blast population co-expressing cytoplasmic CD3 and MPO, detectable only by immunophenotyping.
